notes.title: Secondary Use Guidelines
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404369/7ae069892a8563a221726761114c441498f07154.png[/img]

[h2]-Secondary Use Guidelines-[/h2]
Streaming the game through some kind of livestreaming service it's totally allowed, and while creating fan-fiction about this game is also allowed, any kind of fan-made products that are sold in exchange of any kind of currency can't be sold by a company, only by an individual, and will also need to specify that they are NOT official, so any client can know that we do not take responsibility or are related with such purchase.

We incentivise to stream or film videos of your adventures with Scarlet, create screenshots, or even art related to your experience with the game, to make your experience with this game and it's world more engaging!
